description: T1 Copper Beech - Crown reduce by 1.5m all round, reducing height from 19m to 17.5m and total spread from 13m to 10m to maintain the tree at a suitable size for its location
decision_conditions: The proposed crown reduction has not been sufficiently justified. No arboricultural evidence has been provided to demonstrate that the proposed works are necessary and the Local Planning Authority is satisfied that the tree is capable of being retained at its current size and form. The Copper Beech makes a positive contribution to local amenity and the proposed works would result in an unjustified loss of amenity. Furthermore, the works would have a detrimental influence on the health and appearance of the protected tree, creating unnecessary pruning wounds which could provide points of entry for decay pathogens, potentially affecting the tree's long-term health, condition and longevity. The proposed works are therefore refused.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
